app.title: Wishka
app.tagline: A wishlist you'll love to share

home.underConstruction: The wishlist service will live here soon. For now — a Paper Ledger design-system smoke test.
home.greeting: Hi, {name}! Your wishlist arrives here in Phase 4.

login.sendFailed: Couldn't send the email — try signing in with Google
login.oauthFailed: Google sign-in failed — use an email code instead

code.title: Code from the email
code.sentTo: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. Check the spam folder too.
code.wrong: {count, plural, =0 {That code didn't work} one {That code didn't work — # attempt left} other {That code didn't work — # attempts left}}
code.expired: The code expired — request a new one
code.tooMany: Too many attempts — try again later or change the email

onboarding.title: Almost there
onboarding.subtitle: A couple of touches and you can start your list. Everything can be changed later.
onboarding.name: Name
onboarding.nicknameInvalid: Only lowercase letters, digits and dashes, 3+ characters
onboarding.currencyHint: Pre-filled for new wishes; each wish can use its own
onboarding.skip: Skip — I'll fill it in later

list.emptyBody: Paste a link to something you want, or fill the card in by hand.
list.title: My list

form.dreamHint: A big dream — something people save up or chip in for
form.linkInvalid: The link must start with http(s)://

detail.giftedHint: Type it yourself — we never suggest from reservations
detail.deleteDesc: You can bring it back within 5 seconds.

archive.title: Archive
archive.countLabel: {count, plural, one {# gift} other {# gifts}} · not counted in the list
archive.empty: Gifts you've already received will live here

groups.emptyTitle: Groups — your favorite people's lists in one place
groups.emptyBody: Create a group and invite the people close to you — their lists will live here.
groups.haveInviteHint: Open the link from the email or message — it leads straight into the group.
groups.inviteHint: Invite the people close to you — their lists will show up here.
groups.revokeBody: The old link stops working. You can create a new one any time.
groups.leaveBody: Wishes visible only to this group will become unavailable to it.
groups.deleteBody: The group disappears for every member. Wishes visible only to it will become unavailable to them.
groups.removeBody: Wishes visible only to this group will become unavailable to them.

invite.title: You're invited to "{name}"
invite.body: Sign in to join — members' lists will show up under People.

parse.parsingSlow: The store is slow — still working…
parse.failedTitle: This store doesn't share data — let's fill it in together
parse.duplicateTitle: This is already on your list
parse.partialNotice: We got some of it — fill in what's missing
parse.quotaExceeded: Parsing limit reached for today — fill in manually
parse.urlInvalid: The link must start with http(s)://

publicList.emptyOwnerHint: Check "Good to know" — there are gift hints there.

share.title: Share
share.restrictedWarningTitle: This wish isn't visible to everyone
share.restrictedWarningBody: Even with the direct link, only the people it's shared with can open it.

params.fillHint: Fill this in so people can gift you better
params.publicNote: Your profile is open by link — anyone you send it to can see it

reserve.confirmBody: We won't tell anyone 😉 The owner will never know the gift is taken.
reserve.unreserveBody: The wish will become available to others again.
reserve.conflictTitle: Oh no, someone just took it
reserve.conflictBody: Someone got there first — see what's still available.
reserve.otherDeviceHint: Was it you who booked it? Open the link from your email to pick it up on this device.
reserve.guestFormTitle: How should we note you down?
reserve.guestNameRequired: Tell us your name — that's how we'll remember the booking
reserve.guestEmailHint: We'll send a confirmation and a link to manage the booking
reserve.guestEmailInvalid: Looks like a typo in the address
reserve.successTitle: Done! We'll remember you on this device
reserve.successBody: The owner won't know a thing — bookings are visible only to the list's guests.
reserve.successEmailPrompt: Leave your email — we'll send a link to manage the booking from any device
reserve.successEmailSaved: Done — the email is on its way
reserve.switchBody: This device already holds another guest's bookings. Switching makes those unreachable here — you'll only be able to get them back via the link in your own email.

myReservations.title: My bookings
myReservations.empty: Gifts you reserve will show up here.
myReservations.emailsNote: We email you about owner changes
myReservations.mergeFound: {count, plural, one {Found # guest booking of yours — move it to your account?} other {Found # guest bookings of yours — move them to your account?}}

service.invalidLinkTitle: This link is invalid or the list was deleted
service.noAccessTitle: This list is only visible to group members
